privacy.title: Privacy Policy & KVKK Disclosure
privacy.subtitle: How is your data protected?
privacy.controllerDesc: Loomy acts as the data controller under Turkish Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK). This text informs you about how your personal data is processed.
privacy.personalDataDesc: Name, surname, email, phone, company details, invoice/payment information, service records, quotation history and signature data on service forms are processed. This data is used solely to manage your business.
privacy.legalBasisDesc: Your data is processed to create accounts, track services, prepare quotations, handle payments and fulfil legal obligations. Legal bases: performance of a contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest and your explicit consent.
privacy.dataSharingDesc: Your data is not shared with third parties unless legally required. Your authorised staff can only access their own business data. Your data is stored on servers in Turkey.
privacy.securityDesc: Passwords are stored as one-way hashes, data is encrypted with SSL/TLS and role-based access control applies. Only your authorised personnel can access your data.
privacy.retentionDesc: Your data is retained while your account is active and for periods required by law. When your account is deleted, your data is permanently deleted within 30 days.
privacy.accountDeletionDesc: You can close your account via 'Delete Account' in your profile. Deletion is irreversible; all data associated with your account is destroyed within 30 days.
privacy.notificationsDesc: You can adjust your notification and communication preferences and opt out of marketing messages.
privacy.rightsDesc: Under Article 11 of the KVKK you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, request correction, erasure and object to automated analysis. For the full list and how to apply, use Settings → Data Subject Rights (KVKK).
privacy.verbisDesc: Where an obligation arises, our processing activities are notified to the VERBIS system of the Turkish Personal Data Protection Authority; our processing inventory is kept up to date accordingly.
privacy.contactDesc: To exercise your rights or request information, contact us below after verifying your identity. Your requests are finalised within 30 days.
privacy.copyHint: Copy the email address and write your request to us from your own email app.
kvkk.rightsDesc: Under Article 11 of Law No. 6698 (KVKK), you have the following rights. Requests are finalised within 30 days.
kvkk.learn: Learn whether your personal data is processed
kvkk.information: Request information if it has been processed
kvkk.purpose: Learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used in line with its purpose
kvkk.transfer: Know the third parties to whom it has been transferred, domestically or abroad
kvkk.rectify: Request correction if processed incompletely or incorrectly
kvkk.erase: Request erasure or destruction under the conditions set out in Article 7 of the KVKK
kvkk.notify: Request that correction or deletion is notified to third parties to whom the data has been transferred
kvkk.object: Object to a negative outcome arising from analysis solely by automated systems
kvkk.claim: Claim compensation for damage suffered due to unlawful processing
kvkk.exportDesc: You can download a copy of your account data as JSON. This supports your right of access under KVKK Art. 11(1)(c).
kvkk.exportError: Could not download your data. Please try again.
kvkk.verifiedDesc: Write to our email to verify your identity and submit your request. Requests without identity verification will not be processed.
kvkk.gdprDesc: If you are subject to the EU General Data Protection Regulation, you also have the following rights:
kvkk.gdprErase: Right to erasure / to be forgotten (Art. 17)
kvkk.gdprComplaint: Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77)
kvkk.requestStepEmail: Open your email with 'Submit Request' and write your request
kvkk.requestStepInfo: Include your name, registered email address and your request
kvkk.requestStepVerify: After your identity is verified, your request is finalised within 30 days
kvkk.responseDesc: Requests are finalised within 30 days in line with Article 13 of the KVKK. A fee may be charged if the request involves additional costs; rejected requests are notified to you with reasons.
kvkk.copyHint: Copy the email address and write to us from your own email app, including your name and registered email address.
kvkk.identityDesc: Your identity must be verified before a request is processed. For the security of your personal data, unverified requests will not be processed.
kvkk.disclaimer: This screen provides information to help you comply with the law and is not legal advice. For a full assessment, we recommend consulting an independent legal adviser.
